description: Powerful 800W Motor & 26 mm Drilling Capacity: The EASTMAN EHD-26N Hammer Drill comes with a strong 800-watt motor designed for powerful drilling performance. With up to 26 mm drilling capacity, it is suitable for demanding drilling applications in concrete, masonry, wall surfaces, and other tough materials. SDS-Plus Chuck System for Better Power Transfer: Equipped with an SDS-Plus system, this rotary hammer drill provides secure bit holding and efficient power transmission during hammer drilling. The SDS-Plus design helps users change bits quickly and ensures stable performance during heavy-duty drilling work. High Impact Rate & Fast No Load Speed: With a maximum impact rate of 0-5500 BPM and no load speed of 1300 RPM, this hammer drill delivers fast drilling action and strong impact force. It helps improve working speed and efficiency for construction, installation, renovation, and repair jobs. Reversible Switch for Convenient Operation: The reversible switch feature allows forward and reverse rotation, making it easier to remove stuck drill bits and perform drilling tasks with better control. This feature adds convenience for professional users as well as regular workshop applications Complete Package with BMC Box, Drill Bits & Carbon Set: The product comes with a BMC box for safe storage and easy carrying. It also includes free drill bits in 6 mm, 8 mm, and 10 mm sizes along with a free carbon set, making it a practical ready-to-use package for drilling applications.
